neighbours.label: future-tense markers (will, 'll, gonna, future)
fire: I think the new bridge will open sometime next spring.
She says she'll call the plumber after lunch tomorrow.
We're gonna need a bigger table for the holiday dinner.
The study has implications for future treatments of the disease.
The committee will decide on the budget next week.
Don't worry, they'll be fine once the storm passes.
Planners hope the park will attract more families.
He promised that he'll finish the report by Monday.
quiet: I think the new bridge opened sometime last spring.
She says she called the plumber after lunch yesterday.
We needed a bigger table for the holiday dinner.
The study has implications for current treatments of the disease.
The committee decided on the budget last week.
Don't worry, they were fine once the storm passed.
Planners say the park attracted more families.
He said that he finished the report on Monday.
